reason: Article 9 of the EU AI Act pertains to the obligations of providers of general-purpose AI models, which is unrelated to the technical control of allowlisting and least-privilege for APIs and connections.
Article 15 addresses the obligations of users of high-risk AI systems, focusing on their responsibilities in using the system, not on the underlying network or API security controls.

Article 17 outlines the obligations for providers of high-risk AI systems, which are related to the system's lifecycle and risk management, not to the specific technical implementation of network access controls.
